evidence.quote: Times are particularly difficult for residents of our low- and moderate-income communities who are struggling more than ever to support their families, obtain affordable housing, and access basic services.
At this point, I am pleased to tell you that recent anecdotal evidence leads me to believe that conditions are improving for small businesses.
The lack of jobs was the dominant theme in the first year of data collection
Because jobs and the needs of low- and moderate-income communities remain a priority for us, we will continue to foster collaborative efforts in hopes of additional innovative responses.
